svg.text: Cut 451 mm of 40 x 5 mm flat bar; square and deburr the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights up from the bottom end; the front is the face away from the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saddle screws: 5.5 mm, 14 mm each side of centre, 67 and 442 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersink from the front so M5 countersunk heads sit flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross arm bolts: 5.5 mm, 10 mm each side of centre, 16.5 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Adapter plate bolts: 5.5 mm on the centre line, 119, 169, 316, 386 up

svg.text: (plain holes: the countersinks are in the plates).

svg.text: The saddle centres are 51 and 426 up (375 mm apart).
